posts.title: #KraftMayoPartner  The best kind of appetizers are those that celebrate the flavors of the season.  Bonus if they can be whipped up quickly and are versatile enough to handle a few substitutions. This one checks all three boxes.  Juicy grilled peaches, jammy pickle-y onions, and a wildly creamy whipped feta (thanks to @Kraft Sauces ), all topped off with fresh basil and hot honey. Here’s how to make it!  Ingredients: 1/2 cup water 2 teaspoons hot honey + more for drizzling  2 red onions, thinly sliced Kosher salt 1/2 cup red wine vinegar  2 ripe peaches, halved and pitted Olive oil 6 slices sourdough bread 8 ounces block feta 4 ounces cream cheese 3 tablespoons Kraft Mayo 1/4 cup basil leaves  For the agrodolce onions, combine water and honey in a medium saucepan; bring to a simmer over medium heat. Add onions and 2 teaspoons kosher salt and stir to combine. Reduce heat to low, cover, and cook until onions are tender and translucent, about 25 minutes.  Stir in vinegar, increase heat to medium and cook, uncovered, until most of the liquid has evaporated, about 5 minutes; set aside to cool.  Heat a gas grill to high. Meanwhile, brush both cut sides of peaches with olive oil and brush both sides of bread with olive oil and sprinkle lightly with salt.  Place peaches, cut side down, on grill grate and grill until charred, 3–4 minutes, flip and continue to grill until charred on second side, 3–4 minutes.  Place bread on grill grate and grill until lightly charred, about 1 1/2 minutes per side.  For the whipped feta, add feta and cream cheese to a food processor and process until smooth. Add Kraft Mayo and continue to process until very smooth and creamy.  Spread whipped feta onto a serving plate. Spoon about 1/4 to cup agrodolce onions over top (you’ll have a lot leftover—use them on other dips, sandwiches, pizzas, etc). Cut peaches into chunks and arrange over onions. Sprinkle basil over top and drizzle with hot honey. Serve with grilled bread.

posts.title: Crispy Honey Chipotle Chicken Tacos 🍯🌮 If you don’t already have the @ReciMe | Save recipes app, check out the link in my bio to download it so you can save unlimited recipes like this one with my code “thecontrarianmoney” #recimepartner  Make these tonight. These are the best homemade tacos you’ll ever make. Crispy, cheesy, and packed with flavor. And the sauce… so good. If you’re always looking for new dinner ideas, you’re in the right place. That’s why I share simple and affordable meals that save you time and money. Follow for more Weeknight Staples. Ingredients • 2 lbs chicken breast • ¼ cup sour cream • 2–3 chipotle peppers in adobo • 2 tbsp adobo sauce • 2 tbsp honey • Juice of 1 lime • 2 garlic cloves • 1 tbsp olive oil • 2 tsp chili powder • 1 tsp cumin • 1 tsp smoked paprika • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp onion powder • 1½ tsp kosher salt • ½ tsp pepper • Small flour tortillas • Mozzarella cheese • Avocado oil (for crisping tacos) Honey Chipotle Sauce • ¾ cup Greek yogurt • ¼ cup light mayo • 4 chipotle peppers (2 if you don’t want it as spicy) • 2 tbsp adobo sauce • Juice of 1 lime • 1 tbsp honey • 4 garlic cloves • ¼ tsp salt • ½ cup cilantro • Water to thin Instructions 1. Add all marinade ingredients to a food processor and blend until smooth. Pour over chicken and marinate at least 30 minutes (best 2–4 hours). 2. Cook chicken in a skillet over medium-high heat until slightly charred and caramelized. 3. Blend together all honey chipotle sauce ingredients until smooth. Add water if needed to thin. 4. Add cheese to one side of a tortilla, chicken, more cheese, then fold over. 5. Cook in a pan with a little avocado oil until golden and crispy. Serve with the honey chipotle sauce.
